message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code uses urlretrieve to download datasets from plain HTTP URLs with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication mechanism.

No detected label flipping detection: The code loads and uses ground-truth label arrays directly without any validation of label distributions, comparison against an expected label set, or use of label-noise detection tools.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is applied to the hyperspectral data during preparation; samples are consumed as-is after loading.

No detected model integrity verification: The --restore argument allows loading arbitrary checkpoint weights, but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed before loading the weights.

No detected label distribution validation: The code references class balancing via inverse median frequency weights (compute_imf_weights) but does not validate expected label sets or detect anomalous label distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the visible training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splits are performed via sample_gt, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no cryptographic isolation of the test set, and no mechanism to prevent the test set from influencing training decisions.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads hyperspectral data and passes it directly to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is present that checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or any other sanity constraints before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses CNN/SVM models on hyperspectral image data, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
